Hi Emma — thanks for the quick reply and the stakeholder list. To your questions:
1) We recommend starting with synthetic data (we'll provide a data template) for the first iteration to validate functionality and avoid any compliance gating. For the second iteration we can work with a narrow, de-identified dataset under a short Data Processing Agreement (we have a template) if you want to validate latency/throughput on realistic payloads.
2) During the POC our SE team (Jasmine, cc'd) will own perf tuning. Typical support includes: config for batching/KV caching, a recommended quantization profile for your model family, and a short runbook of kernel and concurrency settings. If you need deeper perf engineering we can include a dedicated infra hour package.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-10-06 10:00 AM PST — agenda: stakeholder alignment (15m), POC scope & success criteria (25m), infra & access checklist (15m), next steps & owners (5m). Does that work for you and Liam?

I'll also drop a first-pass MAP outline into the GDoc with lane owners — feel free to edit.

Thanks,

Sergio
